Chip coverage and top-level files from the README usage table: YM2612 -> jt12.v, YM2610 -> jt10.v, YM2203 -> jt03.v; YM3438 per the README opening line "fully compatible with YM2612/YM3438 (Megadrive), YM2610 (NeoGeo) and YM2203".
